description: Foot d’Actu — trois actualités football racontées comme un mini-film d’animation 3D stylisé.
voixNarrateur: French male sports-news narrator, energetic and conversational, medium-low voice, crisp diction, fast but perfectly understandable, confident without shouting. Exact same voice in every clip.
styleGlobal: STRONGLY STYLIZED PREMIUM 3D ANIMATED FEATURE FILM. Mature natural athletic adult anatomy combined with clearly stylized animated-feature faces and materials. Simplified sculpted facial planes, expressive animated eyes, smooth matte skin with ZERO pores, sculpted hair masses, polished soft materials, colorful cinematic lighting. Never photorealistic, never live action, never sports-game CGI, never uncanny valley.

reglesGlobales.proportions: Adult footballers keep mature natural athletic anatomy, approximately 7 to 7.5 heads tall. Normal necks, shoulders, hands and limbs. No bobble-head, no chibi, no childlike proportions.
reglesGlobales.visages: Faces remain strongly stylized even when the body proportions are natural. No pores, no photographic skin, no individual photographic hair strands.
reglesGlobales.identite: Every identifiable footballer must preserve the attached master character sheet. Never replace one player with another and never create a generic identifiable player.
reglesGlobales.agnes: The supplied image is the exact first frame and visual truth. Agnes animates the existing image; it must not redesign the scene.
reglesGlobales.silence: OFF-SCREEN NARRATOR ONLY. Every visible footballer, coach, staff member and crowd member stays silent with mouth closed and zero lip-sync.
reglesGlobales.texte: Existing scoreboard and readable text remain unchanged during the video. Never generate new readable text during animation.
reglesGlobales.camera: One motivated camera movement per clip. No random orbit, no handheld shake, no impossible camera move.
reglesGlobales.continuite: No new players, no face morphing, no kit changes, no number changes, no invented POV.

STRONGLY STYLIZED PREMIUM 3D ANIMATED FEATURE FILM, never photorealistic; mature natural athletic anatomy, stylized animated faces, poreless materials; preserve the attached player sheet identity exactly. Native vertical 9:16, single continuous image. No readable text other than what is listed.

agnesVideoPolicy.sourceFrame: absolute first frame and visual truth
agnesVideoPolicy.oneClip: one continuous action plus one simple camera move
agnesVideoPolicy.narration: off-screen narrator only; every visible person silent, mouth closed, zero lip-sync
agnesVideoPolicy.text: existing text and scoreboards remain fixed; never create new readable text during video
agnesVideoPolicy.facts: facts not visible in source are carried by narration instead of invented visual events
agnesVideoPolicy.continuity: no new players, no wardrobe changes, no face morphing, no invented POV
agnesVideoPolicy.duration: durée calée sur la narration : ~3,3 mots/s + 1 s, fin de phrase imposée dans le prompt
agnesVideoPolicy.keyframes: imageFin sur les plans 01 (crane pull-back), 03 (tracking jusqu'à Olisé) et 07 (sortie tunnel) ; les autres plans en image de départ seule

prononciation.Olise: écrit « Olisé » dans les narrations pour obtenir o-li-zé
prononciation.actus: écrit « actu » (sans s) dans les narrations pour éviter « actusse »
